scope.purpose: reconstruct every reference behind matched probe hashes and define the evidence response before any candidate execution

decision.task_quarantine_rule: quarantine every task referenced by any matched critical-pattern hash after reconstructing all deduplicated references
decision.threshold_rule: do not weaken or reinterpret the frozen zero-match threshold
decision.suite_rule: RULER v1 remains failed even if critical matches localize to a subset of tasks
decision.required_next: freeze a new evaluation-manifest version before candidate results; either replace/regenerate the quarantined QA cells with data demonstrably disjoint from the training inputs and rescan, or explicitly remove them and add an independent source-document QA guardrail
decision.allowed_reporting: the failed audit and task-localized overlaps may be reported descriptively; matched candidate/control results may only be labeled contaminated sensitivity analysis
decision.forbidden_claim: neither zero matches in other tasks nor shared training windows establishes contamination-free data or absolute long-context capability

required: all matched hash reference counts reconstructed exactly
affected case and task-length cell counts
unchanged threshold and failed v1 decision
explicit non-claims and next manifest action
non_claims: a task without a detected match is contamination-free
the sampled proxy windows represent all future training data
exact token overlap proves the provenance of a packed training example
shared contamination makes an absolute capability score valid
post-audit task quarantine retroactively makes evaluation manifest v1 pass
